name: Vercel
one_liner: Frontend cloud platform for deploying web apps, with a REST API, TypeScript SDK and official MCP server.
auth_notes: REST API and @vercel/sdk authenticate with a Vercel access token. Sign in with Vercel is an OAuth 2.0/OIDC identity provider; Vercel MCP authorizes clients with OAuth.
access_notes: Access tokens are self-serve; a free Hobby plan exists. Some features are plan-gated (account webhooks are Pro/Enterprise). Rate limits apply per action.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve access tokens, a large documented REST reference (~255 operations), SDK, rate limits and an official MCP. Only account webhooks are paid-plan gated.

access.quote: Our Hobby plan is free and a great way to get started.
